summary: Devin for Startups gives early-stage teams $65K to build with the AI software engineer: $15K in Devin credits loaded into the account the day the startup is approved, plus a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $50K in grants on the next $100K of usage. Accepted startups also get unlimited seats as an advertised program benefit (not a statement about the ordinary Teams plan), invitations to founder meetups and early-access previews with the Cognition team, and a Devin swag pack. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The linked application asks for the email you will use to set up Devin and says you should be a GitHub organization admin; Slack-admin access is recommended, not mandatory.
claim_steps: Prepare the email you will use to set up Devin. The linked application says you should be a GitHub organization admin; Slack-admin access is recommended, not mandatory.
Apply through https://devin.ai/startups and describe the startup; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
If approved, follow Cognition’s account/setup instructions. The program says $15K Devin credits are loaded on approval and advertises unlimited seats as a program benefit.
For additional matching grants, review the reload terms: dollar-for-dollar match up to $50K; spending $50K yields $100K of matched usage.
Confirm any subscription/card prerequisites with Cognition before paying; the public startup page does not instruct applicants to purchase the ordinary Teams plan before applying.
